title: exec staff meeting prep notes - 2026-03-08
content:
Purpose: prep for Thu 9:00am exec staff meeting (30m). Quick sync on top risks, decisions needed, and 1-2 asks for the broader leadership group.

Attendees (expected): CEO (Ava), CTO (Riley), Head of Eng (Sana), Head of Product (Mikhail), Head of Sales (Priya), Jordan (me)

Agenda (30m):
- 0-5m: quick wins / morale (Ava)
- 5-12m: Capacity & Dedicated onboarding update (Sana) - decision: increase Dedicated ramp target?
- 12-20m: Production incident trend / SLOs (Riley) - ask for temporary escalation policy change
- 20-26m: Pricing & packaging brief (Mikhail) - review proposed guardrails for enterprise credits
- 26-30m: Quick action items and owners (Jordan)

Prep notes / talking points (Jordan):
- Capacity & Dedicated:
  - Current: 78% utilization across dedicated pools; high tail at 95th p95 latency on multi-model traffic.
  - Ramp: onboarding plan for 3 enterprise customers next quarter - need to confirm extra 8 reserved GPUs (estimate 2 weeks lead time to provision).
  - Ask: approval to allocate +8 GPUs from pool (budget neutral within Q2 capex) OR accept slower onboarding.
  - Risk: if we don't provision, onboarding could slip 4-6 weeks and push ARR recognition to Q4.

- Production incidents / SLOs:
  - Trend: 3 Sev2 incidents last 30d, mostly KV cache eviction-related latency spikes after long-running chats; mitigation in flight (patch in canary).
  - SLO health: overall success rate 99.4% vs target 99.7% (monthly window) - need temporary acceptance or fast fix.
  - Ask: agree to a 2-week temporary SLO relaxation for affected routes while we roll out patch and additional monitoring.

- Pricing / Enterprise credits:
  - Pilot offer: 6-8 weeks free credits for top 3 logos to accelerate migration. Finance concerned about burn; sales pushing for aggressive credits.
  - Proposal: cap credits at $X/month per customer and require commitment terms (6/12mo) + usage thresholds.
  - Ask: leadership sign-off on cap + commit term today or we revert to conservative credits.

Metrics snapshot to have on-hand (short):
- Hosted API: 1.2B tokens/month; avg request latency 125ms; token cost $0.0004/token (internal unit).
- Dedicated: 78% util, 95th latency 420ms on mixed workloads; expected demand +15% wk-over-wk for next 6 weeks.
- Incidents: 3 Sev2 (30d), 1 Sev1 (2 months ago, resolved)

Decisions needed (explicit):
1) Approve +8 GPU provisioning for Dedicated ramp (owner: Sana) - yes/no today
2) Approve 2-week temporary SLO relaxation for affected routes (owner: Riley)
3) Sign off on enterprise credits cap + term (owner: Mikhail + Finance)

Open questions / risks to highlight:
- Procurement lead time: procurement says GPUs can be provisioned in 10-14 business days if we declare priority. Confirm if we want to declare priority.
- Cost impact: Finance wants clearer estimate of ARR upside vs credit burn; Mikhail to provide short doc.
- Communications: if SLO relaxed, how do we communicate to customers (public status page vs targeted comms)? Recommend targeted comms + post-mortem to affected customers.

Action items (to capture in meeting and follow up):
- Sana: confirm ability to allocate +8 GPUs and cost/availability (due: 2026-03-10)
- Riley: finalize canary patch rollout plan and monitoring dashboard for KV cache (due: 2026-03-09)
- Mikhail + Finance (Priya): finalize credits cap proposal with two scenarios (conservative/aggressive) (due: 2026-03-11)
- Jordan: prepare 2-slide summary (capacity ask + SLO rationale) for the meeting (due: 2026-03-08 08:30am) - attach to calendar invite
- Ava: confirm exec brief recipients and whether legal needs to be looped for enterprise credits (due: 2026-03-08 EOD)

Follow-ups after meeting (notes for exec admin):
- If GPUs approved, start procurement ticket and notify solutions-eng for onboarding schedule.
- If SLO relaxation approved, issue targeted customer comms and add a post-mortem deadline (2 weeks).
- Track action item progress in weekly exec tracker (link: CONFLUENCE-1234)

Notes to self / scratch ideas (unpolished):
- Consider a small BTR (beta traffic ramp) for the new dedicated customers to smooth peak tail. Outline auto-fallback to hosted for spikes.
- Longer term: need product flagging for cache-heavy chats to route to optimized pools (ask Sana engineering to prioritize next sprint).

Quick links to reference in meeting:
- Dedicated capacity dashboard (internal): https://app.internal/redwood/dedicated/dashboard
- Incident timeline (Jira): JIRA-9812
- Pricing scenarios doc (draft): CONFLUENCE-PRICING-2026
- Draft communication template: docs/comm_templates/slo-relaxation-draft.md

End.
